home.aboutTitle: Your comfort, security & peace of mind is our mission!
home.ourMissionDesc: To transform home renting in Ethiopia by delivering transparent property listings, verified landlords, and hassle-free move-in services.
home.ourVisionDesc: To be the go-to home rental and property management platform across Ethiopia and East Africa.
home.smartMoveInDesc: Move-in deep cleaning, property inspection, and tenant moving & logistics — with automated price estimation, appointment scheduling, and verified provider assignment.
home.howItWorksSubtitle: From searching verified listings to signing your digital lease and moving in—renting a home in Ethiopia is fast and secure.
home.step1Desc: Filter apartments, villas, and townhouses by location, monthly budget, bedrooms, and amenities across Addis Ababa.
home.step2Desc: Book in-person physical property walkthroughs or 360° virtual tours directly with verified property owners.
home.step3Desc: Pay security deposit and first month's rent securely via Chapa with instant digital lease contract generation.
home.step4Desc: Schedule move-in deep cleaning, luggage transport, key collection, and access 24/7 tenant maintenance support.
home.appTitle: Manage Rent, Chat & Browse On the Go
home.appSubtitle: Download the Ethio Delala mobile application to get instant alerts on new listings, pay rent via Telebirr or CBE, and contact landlords 24/7.
home.footerTagline: Connecting landlords, renters, and licensed agents across Ethiopia.

ecosystems.title: One Platform. Four Connected Ecosystems
ecosystems.subtitle: Delala Home Rentals unifies home rentals, tenant services, landlord management, and Chapa rental contracts into a single intelligent digital infrastructure.
ecosystems.eco1Desc: Browse verified apartments, luxury villas, studio flats, townhouses, and commercial rentals across Addis Ababa with direct landlord inquiries.
ecosystems.eco2Desc: On-demand property inspection, move-in deep cleaning, tenant relocation logistics, locksmith, and home repair services.
ecosystems.eco3Desc: Comprehensive management dashboard for homeowners, landlords, and real estate agents to list units, vet tenants, collect rent, and manage leases.
ecosystems.eco4Desc: Centralized lease contract & payment engine powered by Chapa for instant rent transfers, security deposit escrow, digital receipts, and audit logs.

landlordCta.feat1Desc: No upfront fees or hidden broker cuts
landlordCta.feat2Desc: Direct deposits to your bank account
landlordCta.feat4Desc: Legal protection under Ethiopian civil law

virtualTour.title: Interactive 360° Virtual House & Room Walkthrough
virtualTour.subtitle: Inspect every corner of your future Ethiopian home before booking an in-person walkthrough. Powered by interactive 3D spatial canvas rendering.
virtualTour.livingDesc: Panoramic double-height glass windows with Bole Medhaniallem skyline views, plush velvet seating, and built-in ambient LED cove lighting.
virtualTour.masterDesc: Spacious master bedroom with walk-in closet, teak hardwood flooring, en-suite marble bathroom with rainfall shower & Jacuzzi.
virtualTour.kitchenDesc: Chef's kitchen featuring quartz stone countertops, Bosch integrated appliances, island breakfast bar, and dedicated pantry space.

securityGuarantee.title: The Delala Rental Security & Escrow Guarantee
securityGuarantee.subtitle: Renting in Ethiopia without stress. Our platform provides complete financial escrow, legally verified contracts, and pre-move inspections.
securityGuarantee.g1Desc: Security deposits are safely held in escrow and released only upon successful key handover & physical walkthrough.
securityGuarantee.g2Desc: Standardized bilingual Amharic & English lease contracts compliant with Ethiopian civil law.
securityGuarantee.g3Desc: High-resolution photo inventory report before you move in to protect your security deposit refund.
securityGuarantee.g4Desc: If the property condition does not match the online listing upon key handover, receive a 100% full refund.

personas.title: Tailored Experiences for Tenants, Landlords & Agents
personas.subtitle: Switch between tenant search mode and landlord management mode to see how Delala unifies Ethiopian real estate.
personas.tenant1Desc: Every house is physically inspected and verified to prevent fake listings or duplicate broker scams.
personas.tenant2Desc: Sign legally binding rental contracts directly from your mobile device with clear deposit terms.
personas.tenant3Desc: Pay monthly rent securely via Telebirr, CBE Birr, or cards with Chapa automatic payment receipts.
personas.landlord1Desc: Receive tenant monthly rent directly into your bank account with automatic monthly reminders.
personas.landlord2Desc: Verify tenant national IDs, employment proof, and rental history before approving lease agreements.
personas.landlord3Desc: Manage maintenance requests, deep cleaning, and tenant onboarding with certified technicians.

about.title: About Ethio Delala
about.intro1: Ethio Delala is Ethiopia's premier property rental and sales platform, connecting verified property owners with renters and buyers across the country.
about.intro2: Our platform provides a transparent, secure, and easy-to-use marketplace for residential properties. We verify both property owners and their documents to ensure a trusted experience for all users.
about.missionDesc: Make property search and rental transparent and accessible for all Ethiopians.
about.visionDesc: Become the most trusted property marketplace in East Africa.
about.forOwnersDesc: List your property, manage rental requests, and find verified renters easily.
about.forRentersDesc: Browse thousands of verified properties across Ethiopia, contact owners directly.
